25.explanation: The Treaty of Sugauli was signed in December 1815 and ratified in March 1816. It fixed the Kali (Mahakali) as Nepal's western boundary.

26.explanation: Lipulekh Pass is near the India–Nepal–China (Tibet) trijunction in the Kalapani area.

27.explanation: The Sugauli Treaty made the Kali (Mahakali) river the boundary. Its source is at the heart of the Kalapani–Lipulekh dispute.

28.explanation: The Kailash Mansarovar Yatra runs through two routes: Lipulekh Pass (Uttarakhand) and Nathu La (Sikkim).

29.explanation: The Ministry of External Affairs organises the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra.

30.explanation: India's Montreux Record sites are Keoladeo National Park (Rajasthan) and Loktak Lake (Manipur). Chilika was removed in 2002.

31.explanation: Tamil Nadu has the most Ramsar sites of any Indian state (about 20).

sources.title: Adda247: Ramsar sites in India 2026, state-wise list

32.explanation: Surha Tal (Ballia, Uttar Pradesh) is a natural freshwater oxbow lake and bird sanctuary that supports many migratory and resident birds.

sources.title: Drishti IAS: Glaw Lake becomes India's 101st Ramsar site

33.explanation: 5 June is World Environment Day. World Wetlands Day is 2 February.

34.explanation: Glaw Lake in Kamlang Tiger Reserve became India's 101st Ramsar site in August 2026, Arunachal Pradesh's first.

sources.title: News on AIR: Glaw Lake designated India's 101st Ramsar site

35.explanation: The Ramsar Convention was signed in 1971 at Ramsar, Iran.

36.explanation: During El Niño the easterly trade winds weaken and upwelling of cold water off South America drops, so the eastern Pacific warms.

37.explanation: A positive Indian Ocean Dipole means a warmer western Indian Ocean and a cooler eastern Indian Ocean.

38.explanation: A gazette notification of 25 March 2026 kept the CPI inflation target at 4% with a 2–6% band for April 2026 to March 2031 (s.45ZA, RBI Act).

sources.title: Business Today: Govt retains inflation target at 4% with 2–6% band

39.explanation: The short-run Phillips curve predicts an inverse link between inflation and unemployment. Stagflation is both rising together.

40.explanation: Cutting quantity at the same price is shrinkflation. Cutting quality at the same price is skimpflation.

41.explanation: At the 3rd India–Nordic Summit (Oslo, 19 May 2026) ties were raised to a Green Technology and Innovation Strategic Partnership.

sources.title: Tribune: India, Nordic nations elevate ties to Green Technology and Innovation Strategic Partnership

42.explanation: The summits were held in Stockholm (2018), Copenhagen (2022) and Oslo (2026). The 4th will be hosted by Finland.

43.explanation: The Nordic countries are Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden.

44.explanation: Iceland and Norway are EFTA members outside the EU. Denmark, Finland and Sweden are EU members.

45.explanation: The usual pairings are Iceland with geothermal energy, Norway with the blue/maritime economy and Finland with telecommunications (Nokia, 6G).

46.explanation: GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City) is in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

47.explanation: The VB-G RAM G Act puts Gram Panchayats at the centre, through Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans for participatory planning and asset creation.

sources.title: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025

48.explanation: Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced and led the national launch from Andhra Pradesh on 1 July 2026. Pawan Kalyan is AP's Deputy CM, not a Union Minister.

sources.title: News on AIR: VB-G RAM G to be launched in Andhra Pradesh on July 1

49.explanation: For most States and UTs with a legislature, costs are shared 60:40 between Centre and State. NE and Himalayan States share 90:10.

sources.title: Viksit Bharat – G RAM G Act, 2025 (fund-sharing)

50.explanation: The four thematic areas are water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood-related infrastructure and mitigation of extreme weather events. Rural financial inclusion is not one of them.

sources.title: Viksit Bharat – G RAM G Act, 2025 (Schedule of works)

51.explanation: Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans are integrated with PM Gati Shakti and GIS-based digital platforms.

sources.title: Viksit Bharat – G RAM G Act, 2025

52.explanation: The Act, which replaced MGNREGA, came into force across all rural areas of India on 1 July 2026.
